objective: Speak with Melor Stonehoof in Thunder Bluff.

description: <name>, Melor Stonehoof has heard of your deeds, and has set a path before you.
If you wish to take it, then go to Thunder Bluff and speak with Melor.  You will find him on Hunter's Rise.
completion: So, <name>, you have come. Now, are you prepared to journey through distant lands?
If so, young <class>, then listen on...
